gloss: to give (charitably); to bless; to bestow

definitions.gloss: to give (charitably); to give alms; to show mercy
definitions.explanation: To give something to someone less fortunate out of compassion or charity.

definitions.gloss: to bless; to bestow; to be blessed with
definitions.explanation: For nature, fortune, or a higher power to grant favorable conditions or gifts. Often used in the passive form 恵まれる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貧|まず}しい→貧しい：02349_mazushii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恵|めぐ}む。
examples.english: To give food to a poor person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道端|みちばた}→道端：28126_michibata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{物乞|ものご}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恵|めぐ}んだ。
examples.english: I gave some coins to a beggar on the street.

examples.japanese: ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧かお⟦{恵|めぐ}み→恵み：10527_megumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧。
examples.english: Please show mercy. / Please give me alms.

⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれた→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格別|かくべつ}→格別：00154_kakubetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Vegetables grown on land blessed with natural beauty are exceptional.

notes:
The passive form ⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧ (to be blessed with) is extremely common and used even more frequently than the active form. It expresses being fortunate or gifted with favorable circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{天候|てんこう}→天候：03558_tenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with good weather
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with talent
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{恵|めぐ}まれる→恵まれる：12619_megumareru⟧: to be blessed with a good environment
- お⟦{恵|めぐ}み→恵み：10527_megumi⟧: alms, charity (noun form)
- ⟦{恵|めぐ}み→恵み：10527_megumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧: welcome rain, blessed rain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to give (charity), to perform — more formal, literary
- ⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to give, to grant — neutral, does not imply charity
- ⟦{授|さず}ける→授ける：10350_sazukeru⟧: to bestow, to confer — more formal, implies granting from above
